item.title: T20 World Cup 2026: Bangladesh remains firm on not visiting India in meeting with ICC citing safety concerns- Report
item.description: The Bangladesh Cricket Board (BCB) officials have reiterated their stance not to travel to India for the T20 World Cup 2026 in a meeting with the International Cricket Council (ICC). The meeting was held on Tuesday afternoon to discuss the Bangladesh team’s participation in the ICC Men's T20 World Cup 2026. item.title: Pakistan-born USA pacer Ali Khan denied India visa ahead of T20 World Cup 2026
item.description: Ali Khan, a fast bowler who plays for the United States of America (USA) and was born in Pakistan, was refused an Indian visa. Ali Khan was a member of the USA's T20 World Cup team in 2024 and played in the Group A matches against India and Pakistan, dismissing Rishabh Pant and Fakhar Zaman, respectively.
